title: Welcome to Aurora
body:
Aurora OS v0.1.0 - Dawn Release

This is the first release of Aurora OS.
Features:
- Custom AISA-64 CPU architecture
- Custom assembler and instruction set
- In-memory filesystem (AuroraFS)
- Desktop environment with windows
- Dock, menu bar, and notifications
- Terminal, Finder, Calculator, Notes
- Activity Monitor, System Settings

Enjoy the Aurora experience!

title: Kernel Boot Sequence
body:
1. BIOS POST and memory check
2. Load kernel from sector 1
3. Display boot logo (ASCII art)
4. Initialize AISA-64 CPU
5. Set up interrupt vector table
6. Load filesystem driver
7. Initialize window server
8. Start desktop environment

Kernel size: 556 bytes

title: Shortcuts
body:
Ctrl+Space  - Spotlight Search
Esc         - Close Spotlight
Ctrl+N      - New Terminal
Ctrl+Shift+A - Activity Monitor

Window Controls:
Red    - Close
Yellow - Minimize
Green  - Maximize

Drag title bar to move windows.
